scope: US insurance claim/auction mechanism plus separately forecast service branches; all model-relative and inferred counts labeled

drivers.name: historical_geography_service_revenue
drivers.use: Immutable historical control, not proof of internal allocation

drivers.name: insurance_service_fraction
drivers.unit: fraction of US service dollars allocated to insurance core and attached services
drivers.limitation: Alternative is a stress, not an independently supported lower bound

drivers.name: cohort_claim_mass
drivers.unit: relative claims by body and age
drivers.source: old engine fleet_data/stock, age_constrained_engine_results.json and historical body births
drivers.use: Controls cohort growth and mix; not an absolute accident/insured exposure census

drivers.name: claims_multiplier
drivers.unit: relative combined claims propensity excluding modeled cohort change and incremental repairable nonfiling
drivers.source: default 1; 0.98 stress is not inferred from repairable-only Boyd data

drivers.name: damage_selection
drivers.unit: conditional total-loss probability and selected auction economics
drivers.limitation: Near-threshold mass and repair/salvage rank dependence are not independently measured

drivers.name: repair_and_vehicle_value
drivers.unit: relative fixed-scope repair cost and pre-loss value within cells
drivers.source: default 1; 0.97 repair stress is not an observed cost decline

drivers.name: expected_salvage
drivers.unit: relative anticipated gross recovery; seller charges subtracted before total-loss comparison
drivers.source: inherited 40%-20% recovery curve times scenario multiplier
drivers.limitation: Not realized auction ASP; response and timing unvalidated

drivers.name: realized_salvage
drivers.unit: relative realized auction price at fixed selected rank
drivers.source: 3.7% scenario continues disclosed FY26Q4 US insurance ASP growth; 6% alternative references prior observed growth, neither is guidance
drivers.limitation: Pure price cases hold expected salvage fixed; not a fully anticipated equilibrium

drivers.name: carrier_allocation_and_mix
drivers.unit: conditional claim weight and allocation fraction
drivers.source: friend workbook extracts in legacy inputs; default neutral YoY, runoff separately selected
drivers.limitation: Total-loss carrier weights transferred to claims under common economics; different carrier terms/weights need separate evidence

drivers.name: routing_CAT_and_sale_timing
drivers.unit: routing fraction, extra CAT unit fraction, conditional sale probabilities
drivers.source: default routing 1, extra CAT 0, sale-equivalent timing
drivers.limitation: Combined CAT baseline; no claim of independent CAT economics. Physical lag requires opening backlog and explicit vintage fees

drivers.name: buyer_and_seller_fees
drivers.source: data/csv/copart_fee_grid_2026-09.csv; preferred share .5, seller .04, fixed buyer fees 110 inherited
drivers.limitation: Schedule observed September26; historical effective dates unknown, buyer/contract mix not measured

drivers.name: title_delivery
drivers.unit: eligible jobs, adoption fractions, incremental recognized USD per job
drivers.source: inherited title .5*$50 and delivery .1*$300; explicit bundling/waiver/recognition overrides
drivers.limitation: External job inputs must cover compatible activity in company-unit scale; net accounting requires net charge input; service historical base assumption separate from forward driver

drivers.name: other_US
drivers.unit: relative fee activity times realized fee
drivers.limitation: Reported noninsurance unit/ASP series includes principal activity and cannot directly populate this branch

drivers.name: international
drivers.unit: relative fee units times reported-currency fee RPU
drivers.source: FY26Q4 service dollars and 3.5% RPU in company call; fee units derived by identity
drivers.limitation: Continuation is not guidance; FX already in reported-currency RPU and cannot be added again

drivers.name: purchased_revenue
drivers.unit: relative purchased units times sale price
drivers.source: flat default; alternative allocates JPM FY27 $721m annual expectation proportionally to prior quarters
drivers.limitation: Alternative price/volume assignment is a normalization, not a JPM quarterly driver disclosure; no effect on service forecast

drivers.name: acquisition
drivers.unit: post-control external revenue in USD millions, net of intercompany eliminations
drivers.source: acv_reconciliation_2026-09-28; control assumed no earlier than FY27Q2 for scenarios
drivers.limitation: No assumed acquired service classification; missing output stays null
